US-01-02 is finished on feature/US-01-02 (not pushed). It follows the owner's DEC-46 answer (option a), and the whole acceptance suite passed on the final head b9c3d38 with a clean tree.

They passed in the JUnit reports of the same run (`junit/unit.xml` and `junit/release.xml`, 0 failures), and CI will read them by id. A spec-compliance review found four 3+ questions without one unambiguous answer (3p-16, 3p-33, 3p-43, 3p-46). I replaced them, plus four advisory ones (3p-04, 3p-21, 3p-29, 3p-39), in commit b9c3d38, before the final run.

- **TC-01-02** covers US-01-02#7, but DEC-44/46 defer it to US-03-01, so CI will not run it. merge-check may report it as unexecuted, as it did for US-01-01#4.
- **The PR body** must include the age-suitability record `docs/delivery/content-checks/US-01-02-3-plus.md` (DEC-46 point 4).

The status is still `in-progress`. Per the brief I did not push or open a PR.
